ctx.x: I mean, Jack Sheldon told me. But the way that came about, well, I was trying to get a record date, you know, I had been trying and this cat wanted to record me when we got to California. So we got to California, he says, "Well, now's the time and we'll do it just before, you know, before the record band." And that's the way it was. C.Q. -- Rush was going to sing the blues. C.Q. Price sang the blues with it, the first time he'd ever sang the blues.

So Rush -- we had Rush. Rush was going to be on my date. Shit, Rush talked to them, man, Rush wanted more money than all the band was going to get. So C.Q. got mad, he said, "Man, fuck Rush. Shit, I sing the goddamn blues. We going to do this record date. To hell with Rush." So that's why he sang the blues. So we did it without -- you know, without Jimmy.
